instruction: Label each province names in Piemonte using horizontally centered Ubuntu:Bold font in Grass GIS.

evaluate.key: lambda dump: (lambda good_opts: any([good_opts({param.get('name'): param.get('value') for param in (data.get('params') or [])}) for win in dump.get('windows', []) if win.get('name') == 'boundary_region@PERMANENT' and win.get('_checked') is not False for data in (win.get('_data') or []) if isinstance(data, dict) and data.get('params')]) or any([isinstance(cmd, list) and len(cmd) > 1 and cmd[0] == 'd.vect' and ((isinstance(cmd[1], dict) and str(cmd[1].get('map', '')).split('@')[0] == 'boundary_region' and good_opts(cmd[1])) or (any([isinstance(part, str) and part.startswith('map=') and part.split('=', 1)[1].split('@')[0] == 'boundary_region' for part in cmd[1:]]) and good_opts(dict([part.split('=', 1) for part in cmd[1:] if isinstance(part, str) and '=' in part])))) for cmd in ([item.get('cmd') for item in dump.get('layers', []) if item.get('name') == 'boundary_region@PERMANENT' and item.get('hidden') is not True] + [data.get('cmd') for win in dump.get('windows', []) if win.get('name') == 'boundary_region@PERMANENT' and win.get('_checked') is not False for data in (win.get('_data') or []) if isinstance(data, dict)])]))(lambda opts: str(opts.get('attribute_column', '')).strip() == 'NOME' and str(opts.get('font', '')).strip() == 'Ubuntu:Bold' and str(opts.get('xref', '')).strip() == 'center')
